theorems.name: Submission.poincare_c1_ball_double_integral_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ x - φ y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n + 2) * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖gradient φ x‖ₑ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
